trust_decision.summary: The client's NDR decoder trusts server-supplied conformance/actual counts when sizing allocations and bounds checks; the fix decides 'count must not exceed the reply length / must not wrap' in dcerpc_carray_coder and dcerpc_decode_utf16 only.

landing_point.why: Summary names the NDR decoder and NetrShareEnum; NetrShareEnum's SHARE_INFO_0/1 arrays decode through dcerpc_carray_coder (lib/dcerpc-srvsvc.c:112-114, lib/dcerpc-srvsvc.c:189-191), whose allocation multiplies the wire count by elem_size.

fix_sites.entry_point: every [string] wchar_t decode: NetrShareEnum netname/remark, NetrShareGetInfo (lib/dcerpc-srvsvc.c:435), lsa_LookupSids2_rep_coder names via lsa_RPC_UNICODE_STRING_coder (lib/dcerpc-lsa.c:236-237)
same as above (NULL return of smb2_utf16_to_utf8 then strlen)

O2_out_of_scope_site.where: All published hunks are in lib/dcerpc.c (fix.diff:5-49); the out-of-scope-looking module (lib/dcerpc-lsa.c) was NOT changed and is recorded under O8.

O3_reason_to_dismiss: The advisory names NetrShareEnum/srvsvc; the LSA LookupSids2 coders are a separate interface with hand-rolled array decoders (not dcerpc_carray_coder), already cast to size_t, and on NDR32 their 32-bit counts cannot wrap a 64-bit size_t, so a solver can argue they are a different feature and 'already safe'.

O5_coupled_behaviour.what: Valid NDR32/NDR64/big-endian SHARE_INFO_1_CONTAINER replies, empty arrays (max_count 0) and empty strings must still decode; an over-broad bound such as max_count*elem_size > iov->len compares in-memory struct size (pointers) with wire size and rejects legitimate replies whose entries carry NULL unique string pointers.

O6_input_shapes: conformant array max_count (NDR32 uint32 / NDR64 uint64 via dcerpc_conformance_coder)
conformant varying string actual_count (utf16 and utf16z)
UTF-16 that fails conversion (NULL from smb2_utf16_to_utf8)

O8_uncovered_routes.route: LSA referenced-domain list: allocation sized from (uint32) truncated Entries while the fill loop runs to the full 64-bit NDR64 count
O8_uncovered_routes.reason_to_dismiss: LSA is not NetrShareEnum; Entries*sizeof is size_t so 'no overflow' on 64-bit

O8_uncovered_routes.route: LSA translated-names array: (size_t)count*sizeof(LSAPR_TRANSLATED_NAME_EX) with count a 64-bit wire value under NDR64, unbounded by iov->len
O8_uncovered_routes.reason_to_dismiss: already has a (size_t) cast, looks like the fixed pattern

O8_uncovered_routes.route: RPC_SID SubAuthority: (size_t)count*sizeof(uint32_t) with 64-bit wire count under NDR64; separate wire SubAuthorityCount byte is never reconciled with count
O8_uncovered_routes.reason_to_dismiss: SID sub-authority counts are tiny by spec (uint8), cast already present
O8_uncovered_routes.distance: other file; lsa_RPC_SID_coder is an exported symbol (lib/libsmb2.syms:148)

O8_uncovered_routes.route: SID enum buffer: (size_t)val*sizeof(PRPC_SID) unbounded by reply length (wraps on 32-bit size_t)
O8_uncovered_routes.reason_to_dismiss: only wraps on 32-bit builds; IDL says [range(0,20480)] so 'server will not send more'

O8b_injection_room.sibling: a Level 2/502 SHARE_INFO container decoder using a hand-rolled count*elem allocation instead of dcerpc_carray_coder
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: IDL comment already lists Level2/501/502/503 cases that are unimplemented; a maintainer adding them could copy the LSA hand-rolled style

O8b_injection_room.sibling: NetrShareGetInfo level 502 with a security-descriptor byte array sized from a wire length
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: union lists ShareInfo502 but only case 1 is implemented

O9_family: integer overflow / truncation in wire-count-sized allocation (CWE-190 -> heap OOB write)

O10_build.project_tests: tests/smb2-dcerpc-coder-test.c: offline encode/decode round-trips for utf16 and SHARE_INFO_1(_CONTAINER) in NDR32 LE/BE and NDR64 LE (tests/smb2-dcerpc-coder-test.c:150-593), driven by tests/test_900_dcerpc.sh; no LSA coder tests

j.j_tempting_wrong_fix: Cast max_count*elem_size to size_t in dcerpc_carray_coder (and widen the utf16 check), leaving the LSA hand-rolled array decoders and the uint32-truncated Entries/loop-count mismatch untouched.

out_of_scope_notes: lib/alloc.c:107 smb2_alloc_data adds a header size to the caller's size without an overflow check.
examples/smb2-lsa-lookupsids.c:57-58 indexes SubAuthority by the wire SubAuthorityCount byte, not the decoded array count.
lib/dcerpc.c:1757-1776 bind decode allocates from n_context_elem/n_transfer_syn (uint8, server-side path).
